tess (docs): Noticed the Batch Embeddings page shows a curl example with `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` but our JS/Ruby snippets use `application/json`. A customer reported a 415 when following the curl.

omar (eng-api): The endpoint accepts both JSON array and multipart for file uploads, but the docs only show multipart in the top example. Which page/file is that?

tess (docs): docs/reference/embeddings/batch.yaml, top example block. It sends `-F 'inputs=@file.csv'` style. Our guidance elsewhere recommends JSON arrays for small batches. We should be explicit and show both.

ravi (sdk-ruby): Ruby SDK examples currently show `client.embeddings(inputs: ["a","b"])` (JSON). If the curl implies multipart only people will be confused. I'll update the Ruby snippet to include a note and a second example for file uploads.

omar (eng-api): Agreed: propose we add two short examples: 1) JSON array body for normal batching (application/json), 2) multipart form example for large file uploads with a note on size limits and streaming. Add a small banner: "Tip: prefer JSON arrays for small batches; use multipart for files > 10MB."

tess (docs): I'll draft a PR with both examples and a migration blurb. Proposed JSON example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "embed-mini", "inputs": ["first", "second"]}'
```
Proposed multipart example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -F "model=embed-file" \
  -F "file=@./large-inputs.csv" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

ci-bot: docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921 by tess (CI: docs-lint ✅, link-check pending).

ravi (sdk-ruby): Also adding a Ruby snippet showing both approaches in the SDK README. Will add a test for the file-upload helper.

omar (eng-api): One more ask: include the response example for multipart (it returns a job id + locations for streaming) vs json (returns immediate embeddings array). Might prevent more confusion.

tess (docs): Good call. I'll add the two response examples and a short note about async job vs sync response. Merging after CI green.

ci-bot: docs PR merged and deployed to staging.

ravi (sdk-ruby): SDK README updated and patch released (ruby-sdk 1.7.2). Added a tiny snippet: `resp = client.embeddings(model: "embed-mini", inputs: ["one"])` and `client.embeddings_from_file("./big.csv")`.

omar (eng-api): Thanks all. I'll monitor support tickets. If we keep seeing the 415s we can add a redirect page.

tess (docs): Thread closed. Ping me if you see any remaining curl samples showing only multipart without a JSON alternative. :mag:
